literal: If goodness is desired, possession of shame is required; if noble lineage is desired, let one desire humility towards everyone.
translation: If one desires moral excellence, one must possess a sense of shame; if one desires to preserve a noble lineage, one must practice humility towards everyone.
modern: ஒருவர் தனக்கு நன்மையை விரும்பினால் நாணத்தைக் கொண்டிருக்க வேண்டும்; தன் குலத்தின் பெருமையை விரும்பினால் எல்லாரிடமும் பணிவைக் கொண்டிருக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the essential qualities needed for personal virtue and family honor. To achieve moral goodness (நலம்), a person must have a sense of shame (நாண்) that holds them back from doing wrong. To maintain the dignity of a noble lineage (குலம்), one must cultivate humility (பணிவு) towards all people. True nobility is thus defined not by pride or birth, but by the practice of modesty and respectful humility.
